title: failed
description: The watcher saw the run fail, or be cancelled (note cancelled). Run id unknown means it failed at launch. Replay-prone: never sets a stage. Written by: pipeline-watch.sh (actor watcher). Applied after the envelope by event.schema.json.

run_id.description: The run, or "unknown" when it failed before it had an id.

branch.description: The run's branch. The watcher always sets it (the issue comes from its issue-<N>).

head.description: The run's head sha; for an unknown run the head as the runs list printed it, possibly short.

note.description: Legacy machine-read note: cancelled for a cancelled run, null for a failed one. Read by the factory loop (runState). Frozen until it moves into a payload (docs/events.md, Legacy notes).
